messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-4829 -> model-catalog-service (high error rate)
incident-bot: Alert metadata: service=model-catalog, symptom=500s & tokenizer mismatches, severity=high
alice: acked PD-INC-4829 (alice) :white_check_mark:
oncall-manager: assigning to oncall SRE + runtime team. Paging bob and carol
bob: I’m awake, jumping in. can someone paste the quick metrics?
alice: top-line: 7% of hosted API calls hitting model-catalog are failing to launch model variants, errors are 500s from runtime with tokenizer mismatch logs. Started ~ 05:42 UTC (now ~ 05:55).
carol: I’m on runtime. seeing two catalog revs promoted yesterday with inconsistent tokenizer metadata (utf8 vs bpe). when runtime picks default rev it fails tokenizer check and returns 500. logs: 
```
ERROR runtime.deploy: model_load failed: tokenizer mismatch: expected=bpe tokenizers/v2 but found=utf8
trace_id=ab12ef34
model_id=redwood/insta-small@rev-2026-03-12
```

dave: any customer impact numbers? which customers hit these revs?
alice: initial sampling: ~1200 requests/min, ~85 customers saw at least one 500 in last 10 min. top affected accounts: finsyn (high), educloud (medium). Roughly 1.2% of total platform qps, but for some routes it’s up to 30% error.
bob: good catch. mitigation options: 1) revert catalog promotion for the bad rev, 2) add runtime fallback to previous tokenizer-compatible variant, 3) disable new promotions and route traffic to an older stable model variant.
carol: we can hot-rollback the catalog entry for that model id to the prior revision. takes ~90s to push update + a few mins for runtime caches to observe. fallback routing would be faster if we switch route policy to prefer pinned-variant.
oncall-manager: bob do rollback, carol help verify and watch. alice coordinate customer comms. dave monitor SLO and open PD comms channel.
bob: initiating rollback CLI: 
```
# rollback catalog revision
redwood-cli catalog promote --model redwood/insta-small --revision rev-2026-03-05 --force --message "emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch"
```

incident-bot: command executed by bob at 05:59 UTC: catalog promotion rollback started
carol: seeing rollout event from control plane, invalidation propagated to 3/4 regions, last region pending. runtime logs show model selection switching to rev-2026-03-05 for new requests.
dave: metrics: error rate down from 7% -> 3% in the region that flipped. multi-region aggregate now ~4.1%
alice: pinging support to surface to top-affected customers. drafting status message for finsyn and educloud: "we saw elevated errors due to a model catalog promotion, we've rolled back to a stable revision; some requests may have retried automatically; contact support if you see persistent failures."
bob: can we enable runtime temporary fallback for any requests still hitting the bad rev (to avoid 500s during cache convergence)? carol: yes we have a runtime flag to allow model_variant_fallback=true that will try previous compatible variant. enabling now.
carol: flipping runtime flag in prod: 
```
# enable fallback
curl -XPOST https://runtime-admin/api/flags -d '{"model_variant_fallback":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

incident-bot: runtime flag updated by carol at 06:03 UTC
dave: error rate now 1.1% platform-wide. retries and fallbacks accounting for most recovery. latency steady. customer impact shrinking.
oncall-manager: escalate to oncall-lead if we see >1% sustained after 15m. current looks promising. keep watches for 30m.
bob: root cause summary (initial): control plane accepted a catalog promotion where the tokenizer metadata for the new revision did not match the runtime-verified tokenizer fingerprint. validation step failed to block due to a regression in metadata schema validation that allowed tokenizer_type to be optional. putting hotfix in flight to reject promotions missing tokenizer fingerprint.
alice: updating customers: posted messages to finsyn and educloud via support, included incident reference PD-INC-4829 and suggested retry/backoff.
carol: deploying quick validation patch: 
```
# lint: catalog validation
if not manifest.tokenizer.fingerprint:
  reject_promotion("missing tokenizer fingerprint")
```
deploying to control plane canary now.
incident-bot: canary deploy started for control-plane validation patch at 06:09 UTC
dave: monitoring for any regression from the patch deploy; no impact expected on existing traffic (just prevents future bad promotions).
oncall-manager: summary for execs: short-lived production errors because a catalog promotion slipped validation; immediate remediation via rollback + runtime fallback; active customer comms and patch rolling out. assign follow-ups.
bob: follow-ups: 1) post-mortem owned by runtime eng (bob) due EOD; 2) control plane validation test added to CI (carol) due tomorrow; 3) automated alert when catalog promotions have missing tokenizer metadata (alice) due today; 4) cross-team runbook update to include runtime fallback step (dave) due this week.
alice: agreed. I'll create the support incident and include the list of affected customers + export of error logs.
carol: control plane patch rolled to canary OK, promoting to stable in 10m.
dave: closing PD once error <0.5% for 30m. current 0.4%
bob: monitoring. will escalate if it creeps back up.
incident-bot: PD-INC-4829 status: acknowledged by alice; status=mitigated; last_update=06:32 UTC
alice: moving thread to post-incident channel once PD closed. great job team :thumbsup:
carol: tagging follow-up issues now: INFRA-2376 (validation CI), RUNTIME-4421 (fallback flag permanent), SUPPORT-998 (customer comms), PM to schedule postmortem meeting.
dave: adding notes for SLO reporting: affected window 05:42-06:08 UTC, peak error rate 7%, total impacted customers ~85 (confirmed), mitigation: rollback + runtime fallback, patch in control plane to prevent recurrence.
bob: final: leaving monitoring for 1h then handoff to next oncall.
alice: thanks all.
